Method of Attack: Trojanized cryptocurrency trading application that installs a backdoor Trojan
Installer extracts and runs a secondary program CrashReporter.exe as a backdoor
Scheduled task JMTCrashReporter launches CrashReporter.exe at user login
Backdoor connects to Command & Control server beastgoc.com to receive and execute commands
Attack Vector: Downloading and installing the trojanized JMT Trader application from a fake company website and GitHub repository
